claims.text: Without advanced HIV: induction w IV liposomal amphotericin B + oral flucytosine for 2 to 4 weeks (amphotericin B deoxycholate if no lipid form);
claims.quote: Induction with IV liposomal amphotericin B plus oral flucytosine for 2 to 4 weeks (If lipid formulations of amphotericin B are not available, amphotericin B deoxycholate may be used.)
Induction should be followed by consolidation therapy with oral fluconazole for 8 weeks
Then maintenance therapy with oral fluconazole for 6 to 12 months

claims.text: Advanced HIV: induction w IV liposomal amphotericin B once a day + oral flucytosine for the first 2 weeks;
claims.quote: Induction therapy with IV liposomal amphotericin B once a day plus oral flucytosine for the first 2 weeks of treatment

claims.text: alt: single high-dose IV liposomal amphotericin B (day 1) + oral flucytosine and oral fluconazole for 2 weeks
claims.quote: Alternative induction therapy with single high-dose IV liposomal amphotericin B (on day 1) plus oral flucytosine and oral fluconazole (both oral medications for the first 2 weeks of treatment)

claims.text: Advanced HIV: oral fluconazole consolidation for 8 weeks;
claims.quote: Induction therapy should be followed by consolidation therapy with oral fluconazole for 8 weeks

claims.text: maintenance until CD4 > 100 cells/mcL on ART;
claims.quote: Nearly all patients with advanced HIV infection also need maintenance therapy until CD4 cell counts are > 100 cells/mcL on antiretroviral therapy (4).

claims.text: itraconazole at the same dose is acceptable (check serum levels)
claims.quote: Oral fluconazole is preferred, but itraconazole at the same dose is acceptable; however, itraconazole serum levels should be measured to make sure that patients are absorbing the medication.
